Los Angeles Lakers — injuries
Grimes (finger) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game in Milwaukee.
Grimes injured his finger in Sunday's game against Detroit and didn't suit up for the 124-114 win over Atlanta on Monday. With Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves (illness) both available, Grimes is expected to head back to the bench. However, another absence could mean more minutes for Sandro Mamukelashvili, Ziaire Williams and Collin Sexton.
